text:
maya: quick sync: proposal to emit a tiny billing envelope from runtime only. fields: billing_key (hash), anon_tenant, model, output_tokens, latency_ms, token_bucket, sampler_v. no prompt text.

liam: agree. add sample_reason and sampling_rate so downstream can normalize. also include route_id and short_trace_fp for later stitching.

esther: rollout: emit cost_hint metric immediately (bucketed), ship envelopes to kafka in canary, run stitcher that joins on route_id+trace_fp when billing_key arrives. backfill 48h to validate join coverage.

maya: redaction: runtime must never include prompt or user fields in envelope. full spans only when sampled and tenant opts in. enterprise tenants should opt into full spans via allowlist.

ops-bot: kafka:topic created: runtime.billing.hints (5067890045).

liam: action items: maya draft short RFC + schema; esther implement stitcher consumer; ops schedule canary; liam add envelope SDK in runtime. will reconvene after RFC review. :white_check_mark:
